The commission will develop and coordinate the detailed architectural and multidisciplinary design information required to support procurement, construction and delivery of the upgrade to the existing drivetrain test facility.

title: Gordano School SEND Resource Base Design & Build
description: This Notice is for  the award of Stage 2, of a 2 stage Design & Build process. Stage 1 was published on the UK6 Notice, linked to this Notice.  Principal Contractor for the design & construction to expand the existing facilities for pupils with Special Education Needs and Disabilities (SEND) at Gordano School in Portishead. £1,434,656. Works to be carried out in accordance with the contract.
